title: SRE on-call scratchpad - 2026-03-10
content:
Summary:
- Night shift notes + follow-ups from pages between 02:15-04:40 UTC. Multiple spikes in write latency to the primary redis-layer cluster that cascaded into tail latency for /generate and /embed endpoints. Pager: high latency for model-inference queues on us-west-2.
content_details:
Timeline (UTC):
- 02:12: Pager received: high p95/p99 latency on redis-primary (grafana alert).
- 02:15: Started mitigation: scaled redis-reader pool + enabled read-only failover to replica set (manual failover).
- 02:22: Latency improved for read-heavy paths but write latency persisted.
- 02:30: Spike observed in inference queue length; routed traffic to fallback model variant (small-quantized) to reduce latency.
- 03:05: Prometheus alerts for increased RTO on worker pods (OOMKilled observed on 3 inference pods).
- 03:40: Stabilized after draining a noisy batch job (batching job id: batch-2026-03-10-03), restarted affected pods.
immediate_actions:
- Manual failover triggered to replica, promoted replica to primary for short window (rollback plan ready).
- Ramped up dedicated worker pool for hosted-api temporarily (scale from 20 -> 40).
- Throttled internal background batching job (batch-2026-03-10-03) that was sending very large multi-request batches.
- Created JIRA SRE-4821 to track incident and RCA tasks.
followups_todos:
- [ ] SRE-4821: Full RCA (owner: Olivia Chen) - due 2026-03-13. Include: redis config, failover timeline, why OOMs occurred on inference pods, and whether batching job broke backpressure.
- [ ] INF-1290: Investigate batching job memory profile and add stronger rate/size limits (owner: Noah Chen) - due 2026-03-12.
- [ ] Runbook updates: add explicit step for throttling internal batchers and clear guidance on when to promote replica vs. forced restart (owner: Sophia Wong).
- [ ] Add automated alert to detect "noisy batcher" pattern: high multi-request batch sizes + rising worker OOMs (owner: eng-sre oncall rotations).
- [ ] Post-mortem writeup and customer impact summary for account execs (owner: Olivia Chen).
runbook_notes: - Runbook (pg-batching-runbook) doesn't include: clear command to gracefully drain batcher without losing requests, nor a checklist for safe replica promotion with live traffic.\n- Need to document how to switch traffic to fallback model variants automatically when worker queue length crosses threshold. Currently manual only.
paging_notes_commands:
kubectl get pods -n hosted-api --selector=app=inference -o wide (identify OOMKilled pods)
redis-cli --cluster call CLUSTER FAILOVER (used via automation with emergency guardrails)
airflow pause dag batcher-dag (temporary throttle on internal batching)
./scripts/scale_workers.sh hosted-api 40 (temporary scaling)
unresolved_questions: - Why did the batching job increase batch sizes? Was there a change in upstream producer (e.g., customer-side SDK change)? Link tracking: INF-1290.\n- Should we add backpressure signals in the SDK to avoid giant batched requests reaching servers? (cc: product-hosted-api)
notes:
Notes to self: prioritize runbook edits first - repetitive manual steps cost time. Reminder: schedule a 30-min sync with batcher owners and infra next week.

Short-term checklist for next oncall:
- Watch redis write latency metric: if p95(write) > 50ms for > 3m then consider failover plan.
- Watch worker OOM rate: > 1 OOM / 10m -> scale down batcher ingestion or enable strict request size limits.
- Watch inference queue length: > 200 -> trigger routing to fallback models and alert oncall immediately.
slack_refs: #sre-oncall: thread ts=1710000000.000100 (incident start)\n#prod-batching: convo id 3a9f2b (discussed batcher changes)
impressions: This felt like a classic noisy-job + insufficient backpressure problem. The platform responded well to fallbacks and scaling but runbook/docs need to be clearer to speed first-action steps.
action_items_next: - Draft runbook edits (focus on throttling steps and replica promotion checklist).\n- Add a Prometheus rule prototype for noisy-batcher detection and post it to INF-1290.\n- Kick off memory profiling for batcher code path and set up a small repro environment.
